blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Human feedback can vary in cost and informativeness. Strong feedback can reveal severe errors but is costly, so cheaper quality ratings can help decide which items to annotate. We propose MICRO ( M ulti-Fidelity I mpact C lustered Ro llout), an active search framework that allocates a shared budget to these feedback types to maximise confirmed severe error discoveries. MICRO jointly models ratings and annotation losses conditional on item features to steer acquisition. It clusters acquisitions by their predicted impact on severity probabilities to select diverse candidates, then uses rollout to estimate their discovery value. Experiments on WMT20 English–German show that ratings improve both loss reconstruction and severity prediction. MICRO achieves the highest mean discovery count across four budget and rating cost settings, with similar performance to adapted MF-ENS in one and significant gains over all six comparison policies, including two rollout controls, in the other three ( p < .001 p<.001 ).
blocks.zh: 人类的反馈在成本和资料方面可能有所不同。 强烈的反馈可以揭示出严重的错误,但代价高昂,因此更便宜的质量评级可以帮助决定哪些项目需要注释. 我们提出MICRO(M ulti-Fidelity I impact C lessered Ro lout),这是一个积极的搜索框架,为这些反馈类型分配一个共享预算,以最大限度地实现确认的严重错误发现. MICRO联合模型评分和注释损失以项目特征为引导获取条件. 它通过对严重性概率的预测影响,将采购组合起来,选择不同的候选人,然后利用推出来估计他们的发现价值。 WMT20英语–德语实验显示,收视率既改善了损失重建,也改善了严重程度预测. 多边投资办事处在四个预算和评分成本设置中实现了最高平均发现数,其中一项业绩与经调整的MF-ENS相似,其他三项( < 001 p < 001)在所有六项比较政策,包括两项推出控制,都取得了显著收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Human feedback can vary substantially in informativeness and effort. For example, in personalised ASR for people with complex disabilities, explicitly correcting transcription errors can be very burdensome [ 10 ] . In contrast, providing a simple quality rating is considerably easier. Machine translation deployments [ 3 ] present a similar asymmetry where direct quality assessment can be substantially easier and cheaper than one-to-one correction and post-editing. In particular, Graham et al. [ 9 ] estimated that professional post-editing can cost roughly 10–20 times as much as direct assessment.
blocks.zh: 人类的反馈在信息性和努力方面可以有很大差异。 例如,在针对复杂残疾人的个性化ASR中,明确纠正抄录错误可能非常麻烦[10]. 相比之下,提供简单的质量评级要容易得多。 机器翻译部署[3]呈现出类似的不对称,直接质量评估比一对一的校正和编辑后更简单、更便宜。 特别是,Graham et al. [9] 估计专业编辑后的费用约为直接评估的10-20倍。

blocks.en: To exploit this difference in cost and informativeness, we propose an approach that combines weak and strong feedback [ 21 ] under a shared acquisition budget. Strong feedback reveals an annotation loss, while weak feedback provides a scalar quality rating, much like bandit feedback [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了利用这种成本和资料方面的差别,我们建议一种办法,在共同购置预算下将弱和强反馈结合起来[21]。 强烈的反馈揭示了注解损失,而弱的反馈则提供了标量质量的评级,与强盗反馈(英语:bandit reference [13])很像.

blocks.en: Active search, a variant of active learning [ 19 ] , aims to discover target examples under a limited acquisition budget [ 8 ] . Multi-fidelity approaches extend this problem by allowing observations with different costs and levels of reliability [ 16 ] . In our setting, the relationship between quality ratings and annotation loss is uncertain and must be inferred. We use this mapping for quality estimation (QE), enabling active search to identify severe errors under a limited acquisition budget.
blocks.zh: 主动搜索是主动学习的变体[19],旨在发现有限收购预算下的目标实例[8]. 多可靠性方法通过允许具有不同成本和可靠性水平的观测来扩展这一问题[16]. 在我们的环境下,质量评级与注释损失之间的关系是不确定的,必须加以推断。 我们利用这种绘图进行质量估计,使积极搜索能够在有限的购置预算中找出严重错误。

blocks.en: Quality ratings do not necessarily exactly correspond to annotation loss: for instance, perceived ASR quality can differ from measures based on word error [ 12 ] . Therefore, we model ratings as noisy observations related to annotation loss.
blocks.zh: 质量评级不一定与注释损失完全对应:例如,所感知的ASR质量可以不同于基于词错误的计量[12]. 因此,我们把评级作为与注解损失有关的噪音观察。

blocks.en: We propose MICRO (Multi-fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout), a framework for discovering severe errors using strong and weak feedback under a shared budget. MICRO jointly models annotation losses and quality ratings conditional on item features, then clusters acquisitions by their predicted impact on posterior severity probabilities to select diverse candidates for rollout [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们建议采用多功能影响分组推出(MICRO),这是利用共享预算的强弱反馈发现严重错误的框架。 MICRO联合模型以项目特征为条件进行注释损失和质量评级,然后通过对后期严重性概率的预测影响进行集群收购,以选择不同的候选人推出[2].

blocks.en: Targeted error discovery can reveal systematic model failures more efficiently [ 14 , 18 ] , providing examples which can then support fine-tuning and evaluation. In this work, we evaluate feedback reconstruction and active search, demonstrating that MICRO discovers more severe errors on average than the comparison policies under the same acquisition budget.
blocks.zh: 定向错误发现可以更高效地揭示系统性模型故障[14,18],提供可以支持微调和评价的例子. 在这项工作中,我们评价了反馈重建和积极搜索,表明MICRO发现的平均错误比同一购置预算的比较政策更严重.

blocks.zh: 2 问题的提出

blocks.en: Item features, such as input characteristics, embeddings or model confidence scores, can provide information about the true latent (annotation) loss [ 20 ] . We therefore model this dependence, and then treat ratings as noisy observations related to annotation loss and these features.

For each trajectory, we sample the root’s observation to update the posterior, then simulate greedy acquisitions based on r ¯ t ​ ( a ) \bar{r}_{t}(a) from the full annotation pool, conditioning on every acquisition before choosing the next. Greedy trajectories only use annotations because ratings have r ¯ t ​ ( a ) = 0 \bar{r}_{t}(a)=0 . While full look-ahead is computationally intractable, our rollout evaluates K K roots using M M simulated trajectories of at most H H sequential steps, thus requiring only O ⁡ ( K ​ M ​ H ) O(KMH) simulated steps. 3. We acquire the root with the greatest estimated reward averaged over all the simulated trajectories. We then observe its feedback, update the posterior and then subtract its cost from B B . 4. We repeat steps 1 through 3 until less than one annotation’s cost is left in the budget. A rating can be acquired only if it leaves budget for an annotation to follow.

To reduce redundancy among rollout candidates, we construct a root pool of size K K by selecting the highest scoring candidate per cluster: diversity-based selection also appears in active learning [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们把可能的说明和评分分别分为K / 2 K/2 组,运行 k k - 表示其影响矢量的 [15] 。 然后,我们通过 r (a)\bar{r}_{t}(a) 来评分,然后通过 r}_{ a, t‖ 1\boldsymbol\psi}_{a,t}\|_{1} (2 \ sqrt{2/\pi} 不影响排名)来评分。 为了减少推出候选人的冗余,我们通过选择每组得分最高的候选人来构建一个KK的根库:基于多样性的选择也出现在积极学习中[1]。

blocks.en: We evaluate each root over M M simulated trajectories. For each trajectory, we sample the root’s observation to update the posterior, then simulate greedy acquisitions based on r ¯ t ​ ( a ) \bar{r}_{t}(a) from the full annotation pool, conditioning on every acquisition before choosing the next. To score roots at residual budget δ < 1 \delta<1 , we assign fractional reward δ ​ p \delta p to the next greedy annotation with severity probability p p . Greedy trajectories only use annotations because ratings have r ¯ t ​ ( a ) = 0 \bar{r}_{t}(a)=0 . While full look-ahead is computationally intractable, our rollout evaluates K K roots using M M simulated trajectories of at most H H sequential steps, thus requiring only O ⁡ ( K ​ M ​ H ) O(KMH) simulated steps.
blocks.zh: 我们通过MM模拟轨迹来评估每个根. 对每个轨迹, 我们都会对根的观察进行取样, 以更新后端, 为了在剩余预算 \ < 1\ delta < 1 中得分, 我们给下一个贪婪的注解 p\ 。 贪婪的轨迹只使用说明,因为收视率有r't(a)=0\bar{r}_{t}(a)=0. 虽然完整的外观前方在计算上难以操作,但我们的推出使用最多 H 相继步骤的 M M 模拟轨迹来评价 K K 根,因此只需要 O ⁡( K M H ) O( KMH ) 模拟步骤。

blocks.en: We acquire the root with the greatest estimated reward averaged over all the simulated trajectories. We then observe its feedback, update the posterior and then subtract its cost from B B .
blocks.zh: 我们以所有模拟轨迹的平均最大估计报酬来获得根。 然后我们观察它的反馈,更新后方,然后从BB中扣除成本。

blocks.en: We repeat steps 1 through 3 until less than one annotation’s cost is left in the budget. A rating can be acquired only if it leaves budget for an annotation to follow.
blocks.zh: 我们重复第1至第3步,直到预算只留下一个注释。 只有在将预算留给注解之后才能获得评分。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Feedback Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.1 重建反馈

blocks.en: We benchmark the model on English–German from the 2020 Workshop on Machine Translation (WMT20) dataset [ 6 ] . Translations are scored with strong Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) and a weak 0–6 professional Scalar Quality Metric (pSQM): there are three pSQM ratings per segment.
blocks.zh: 我们从2020年机器翻译工作坊(WMT20)数据集[6]中将英语-德语模型作为基准. 翻译成绩有强的多维质量计量(MQM)和弱的0–6专业Scalar质量计量(pSQM):每段有3个pSQM的收视率.

blocks.en: We choose general purpose text features, concatenating frozen LaBSE embeddings [ 4 ] of source and translation texts, then applying PCA to 32 dimensions and standardising each component. We use document-disjoint calibration, development and test splits. PCA, model fitting and standardisation use calibration data only.
blocks.zh: 我们选择通用文本特征,将冷冻的LABSE嵌入源文本和翻译文本[4],然后将PCA应用到32维,并使每个组件标准化. 我们使用文件分解校准,开发和测试分解. 五氯苯甲醚、模型安装和标准化仅使用校准数据。

blocks.en: For reconstruction, we also optionally calibrate the posterior mean using two monotone functions: y ~ i = c Y ​ ( y ^ i ) , p ~ i = c S ​ ( y ^ i ) , \widetilde{y}_{i}=c_{Y}(\widehat{y}_{i}),\qquad\widetilde{p}_{i}=c_{S}(\widehat{y}_{i}), where c Y c_{Y} and c S c_{S} map the posterior mean to MQM loss and P ⁡ ( Y i > τ ) P(Y_{i}>\tau) , respectively. Both functions are fitted with isotonic regression on calibration data. We avoid selection bias from the acquisition policy by observing feedback at random.
blocks.zh: 对于重建,我们也可选校正后方表示使用两个单调函数:y~i=c Y(y~i),p~i=c S. (y^i),\glassilde{y}_{i}=c_{i}(\glanshat{y}_{i}),\quad\glansilde{p}_{i}=i}=c_{S}(\glanshat{y}_{i}),其中C Y c_{Y}和S c_{S}分别映射MQM损失和PQ(Y i)P(Yi}>\i}>\tau)的后遗症. 这两种功能都配有校准数据的同位素回归。 我们通过随机观察反馈,避免从购置政策中选择偏差。

blocks.en: 4.2 Multi-Fidelity Active Search
blocks.zh: 4.2 多纤维 活动搜索

blocks.en: We evaluate active search by confirmed severe errors discovered, over 1024 paired held-out English–German pools per setting at rating costs ρ ∈ { 1 / 16 , 1 / 8 } \rho\in\{1/16,1/8\} and budgets B ∈ { 16 , 32 } B\in\{16,32\} . These costs represent hypothetical scenarios, not measured MQM/pSQM costs. Each pool contains 128 segments from the test set, which are then shared across policies.
blocks.zh: 我们通过发现的确认严重错误来评价主动搜索,超过1024对对的英格蘭──每个设定的评分成本为 ^ {{1 / 16, 1 / 8}\rho\in {1/16,1/8}和预算B}{16,32}B\in 16,32}。 这些费用是假设的假设情景,不是衡量的MQM/pSQM费用。 每个集合包含测试集的128个部分,然后在政策上共享.

blocks.en: Besides the standard greedy baseline, we also benchmark against annotation-only ENS [ 11 ] , which evaluates every annotation by its immediate reward and the expected top-probability batch value for the remaining budget. We adapt ENS to numerical annotation losses and estimate its expected utility by using 128 samples from the Gaussian predictive distribution. We adapt MF-ENS [ 16 ] from parallel queries to feedback under a shared budget (and numerical annotation losses). It scores each candidate by simulating its observation, followed by a batch of ratings and then a greedy batch of annotations. For each candidate, we simulate 16 possible outcomes and use 32 simulations each for batch size selection and independent evaluation. In line with MF-ENS’s exploration window of one strong-query duration, we limit each simulated rating batch to one annotation’s cost. Simulated batch ratings update only their own segment, while actual observations update the full posterior. “Screen-then-annotate” acquires only the highest scoring ratings, until it reaches a screening quota of B / ( 4 ​ ρ ) B/(4\rho) and then annotates greedily. We then include two rollout controls: “undiversified rollout” selects candidates by highest reward/impact without clustering’s explicit diversity objective, whereas “block-based rollout” enforces diversity by selecting a candidate per document–system block (instead of per cluster). All policies share the fitted feedback model.
blocks.zh: 除了标准的贪婪基线外,我们还参照仅注解的 ENS [11] ,它通过立即奖励来评价每份注解,并评估其余预算的预期最高概率批次价值。 我们通过使用来自高斯预测分布的128个样本,使ENS适应数字注释损失并估计其预期效用。 我们把MF-ENS[16]从平行查询改为在共同预算下反馈(和数字注释损失)。 它通过模拟自己的观察对每个候选人进行评分,然后是一组评分,然后是一批贪婪的注解. 对于每个候选人,我们模拟16项可能的结果,并采用32项模拟,每次用于批量大小选择和独立评价。 根据MF-ENS的探索窗口,我们把每批模拟评级限制在一个注释的成本范围内。 模拟批量收视率仅更新他们自己的片段,而实际观察则更新整个后期. “Screen-when-anotate”只获得最高的评分,直至达到B/(4 ρ)B/(4\rho)的筛选配额,然后贪婪地进行注释。 然后,我们包括两个推出控制: " 分散推出 " 以最高的奖赏/影响甄选候选人,而不将明确的多样性目标组合起来,而 " 块状推出 " 则通过每个文件系统块(而不是每个组群)选择一名候选人来实现多样性。 所有政策都采用适当的反馈模式。

blocks.en: While adapted MF-ENS evaluates all legal acquisitions, MICRO only evaluates K = 12 K=12 candidates with M = 128 M=128 trajectories, chosen for computational practicality (the calibration mentioned in Section 4.1 is not applied in active search). We report mean discoveries and paired differences with 95% confidence intervals and unadjusted two-sided paired t t -test p p -values.
blocks.zh: 虽然经过调整的MF-ENS评价所有合法收购,但MIRO只评价K=12K=12个候选人,其中M=128M=128个轨迹,选作计算实用性(第4.1节中提到的校准在主动搜索中并不适用). 我们报告的是95%的置信间隔和未调整的双侧对子 t -测试p -值的发现和对子差异。

blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.zh: 5.1 反馈重建

blocks.en: Table 1 shows more ratings improve loss reconstruction (and in turn severity prediction). Comparing the calibrated three rating model to pre-rating predictions, MAE is reduced from 1.762 to 1.259 and Brier score from .1248 to .0844. Although the joint model’s MAE is slightly higher than the rating-only baseline with two or three ratings, it consistently improves Brier score. blocks.en: MICRO discovers the largest mean number of severe errors in all four settings (Table 2 ), consistently outperforming greedy, ENS and screen-then-annotate ( p < .001 p<.001 ). The two annotation-only policies, greedy and ENS, achieve similarly low mean yields.

blocks.en: Its relative advantage over these baselines increases with larger budgets. At ρ = 1 / 16 \rho=1/16 , the improvements rise from 34.6 % 34.6\% to 53.4 % 53.4\% over greedy, from 34.5 % 34.5\% to 53.1 % 53.1\% over ENS, and from 10.1 % 10.1\% to 12.4 % 12.4\% over screen-then-annotate, as B B increases from 16 16 to 32 32 . The same holds at ρ = 1 / 8 \rho=1/8 , though the gains are smaller.
blocks.zh: 它相对于这些基线的相对优势随着预算的增加而增加。 在^ = 1/ 16\rho=1/16时,改进率从34.6% 34.6%增加到53.4% 贪婪过度,从34.5% 34.5%增加到53.1% 超过ENS,从10.1% 10.1%增加到12.4% 超过屏幕-当时的注释,B从16增加到32 。 虽然收益较小,但同样维持在 $ = 1/ 8\rho = 1/8。

blocks.en: Adapted MF-ENS and both rollout controls achieve higher mean yields than greedy, ENS and screen-then-annotate in all settings. At ρ = 1 / 8 \rho=1/8 , B = 16 B=16 , MICRO has a similar mean yield ( p = .543 p=.543 , p = .069 p=.069 , p = .232 p=.232 ), and significantly outperforms them at the other three settings ( p < .001 p<.001 ). These comparisons support impact-based clustering, and a plausible explanation for the advantage is that it can reduce overlap and redundancy among candidate roots, allowing rollout to consider a broader range of acquisitions.
blocks.zh: 适应的MF-ENS和两种推出控制都实现了高于贪婪、ENS和屏幕-当时的注释的平均值。 在 ^ 1/8\rho=1/8, B = 16 B = 16 时,MIRCO的平均产量相近(p = 543 p = 543 p ,p = 069 p = 069 p ,p = 232 p = 232),在其他三种设置(p < 001 p < 001)时,其绩效明显高于它们. 这些比较有助于基于影响的分组,对优势的一个合理解释是,它可以减少候选根之间的重叠和冗余,从而可以推出范围更广的购置。

blocks.en: 5.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.3 限制

blocks.en: Although personalised ASR motivates MICRO, we evaluate only on WMT20 English–German translations. Feedback costs are also assumed and standardised: in practice, annotation and rating costs may vary due to factors like item length, error severity or user fatigue.
blocks.zh: 虽然个性化的ASR激励着MICRO,但我们只评价WMT20英文–德文翻译. 反馈费用也假定并标准化:在实践中,注释和评级费用可能因项目长度、误差严重性或用户疲劳等因素而异。

blocks.en: In additional experiments at ρ ∈ { 1 / 4 , 1 / 2 } \rho\in\{1/4,1/2\} , we did not observe any significant improvements by MICRO and the two rollout controls over the baseline acquisition policies. These results suggest that ratings’ informativeness may not justify their cost in those settings, as their value is dataset-dependent.
blocks.zh: 在\\}{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{}}}}\rho\in\}}{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{}}}}的实验中,我们没有看到MICRO的任何重大改进和对基线获取政策的两项推出控制。 这些结果表明,评级的信息性可能无法证明这些环境下的成本是合理的,因为它们的价值取决于数据集。

blocks.en: Since rollout trajectories only include annotations, MICRO is limited in evaluating the benefit of acquiring multiple ratings jointly. Our MF-ENS comparison adapts its parallel setting and binary labels to continuous feedback and a shared budget, so other adaptations could yield different results.
blocks.zh: 由于推出轨迹只包含说明,所以MICRO在评价联合获得多个评级的好处方面受到限制. 我们的MF-ENS比较使其平行设置和二进制标签适应持续的反馈和共享的预算,因此其他的适应可以产生不同的结果.

blocks.en: MICRO’s k k -means step adds additional computational overhead, and we did not compare different methods under equal wall-clock time. However, in our runtime checks, clustering always took over an order of magnitude less time than the rollout phase.
blocks.zh: MICRO的k k - 意思是台阶增加了额外的计算间接费用, 我们并没有在相等的墙点时间下比较不同的方法。 然而,在我们的运行时间检查中,集群总是占据比推出阶段要少的幅度。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Although weak feedback cannot directly confirm a discovery, it can improve quality estimation and guide the acquisition of strong feedback. MICRO jointly models annotation losses and quality ratings, performing active search by combining impact-based clustering with rollout to select acquisitions under a shared acquisition budget.
blocks.zh: 虽然弱反馈不能直接证实发现,但可以提高质量估计,并指导获取强反馈. MICRO联合模拟注解损失和质量评级,通过将基于撞击的集群与推出相结合来进行积极的搜索,以选择共享购置预算下的购置.

blocks.en: Our experiments on WMT20 English–German show improved loss reconstruction and more severe error discoveries when ratings are sufficiently cheap. MICRO achieves the highest mean discovery count across all settings, and significantly outperforms all comparison policies in three settings, including both large budget settings. Comparisons with rollout controls support the benefit of impact-based clustering.
blocks.zh: 我们的WMT20英语-德语实验显示,当收视率足够低廉时,损失重建有所改善,错误发现更为严重。 MIRO在所有环境实现最高平均发现数,并在三个环境,包括两个大预算环境,大大超过所有比较政策。 与推出控制的比较有助于基于影响的分组。

blocks.en: These findings motivate further study on multi-fidelity active search and its application specifically to personalised ASR. Future work should evaluate policies under equal computational budgets and realistic user effort, as well as account for sequences of weak feedback acquisition.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果促使进一步研究多功能积极搜索及其具体应用于个性化ASR的问题。 今后的工作应当评价在平等计算预算和现实的用户努力下的政策,以及反映反馈获取不力的顺序。
